notes: Deadly Plot (FDN), printed: 'Choose one'. The mode is chosen as the spell is cast and only the chosen mode needs a legal target (CR 601.2b-c). Step 1: no creature or planeswalker is on the battlefield (only an artifact), so mode 0 has no target, yet mode 1 casts and returns seat 0's Zombie from its graveyard. Step 2: the graveyard now holds no Zombie, so mode 1 has no target, yet mode 0 casts on the returned Zombie (a creature now) and destroys it. The artifact is never touched.
